}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== {{See also|BeagleBoard Devices|List of SBCs}}
The board can be powered by 2 different methods: *5V/2.5A via 2-pin screw terminal *USB (Type-C) Female
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Microchip]]'' Polarfire MPFS250T FCVG484E SoC FPGA :Processor Quad-Core 64-bit RISC-V (RV64IMAFDC), 64-bit RISC-V (RV64IMAC) @667MHz :FPGA 23K logic elements (4-input LUT + DFF), 68 Math blocks (18×18 MACC) *Storage: 16GB eMMC, 16MB SPI (NOR), TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card *Memory: 2GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM @1866MHz *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) dual-role support and power input *PCI: 1x M.2 (E-Key) *Expansion: 2×46-pin BeagleBone Cape headers, SYZYGY high-speed connector *Power: 5V/2.5A via 2-pin screw terminal or USB (Type-C)
